widgets_values:
Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is the cyborg girl in <Picture 1>: a young woman with a short dark-brown bob, large brown eyes, and two horizontal red war-paint stripes under both eyes, wearing a black high-collar textured bodysuit with purple metallic cybernetic shoulders and arms detailed with silver plating.

summary:

[reference generation] The target video is a 5-second, 16:9 single continuous tracking shot, the first half of a 10-second long take: <Subject 1> sprints toward the camera across a sunlit open ridge against a vast cloud-filled sky; the camera tracks backward at her exact pace and ends mid-arc at a front-right three-quarter angle as her right foot strikes the ground.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - bob haircut, red war-paint stripes, black high-collar bodysuit, and purple metallic cybernetic shoulders and arms retained.

detailed_description:

The target video is a cinematic sci-fi action long take with natural warm sunlight, shallow depth of field, and slight handheld energy.

[Shot 1] A medium close-up tracking shot: <Subject 1> sprints steadily toward the camera across an open sunlit ridge, the vast blue sky with flowing clouds behind her as in <Picture 1>. The camera dollies backward at exactly her pace, holding her centered; her bob whips in the wind, the black high-collar bodysuit ripples, the purple metallic shoulders glint, and the red war-paint stripes stay crisp under her determined eyes. Her gait is a strong rhythmic sprint at about two and a half strides per second, arms pumping with visible cybernetic articulation. In the final second the camera begins a smooth arc toward her right side, ending at a front-right three-quarter angle at the exact moment her right foot strikes the ground.

overall_soundscape:

Rhythmic footfalls on dry hard ground at a steady sprint cadence; wind rush past the microphone; a faint hydraulic servo whirr from her shoulders; controlled rhythmic breathing.

non_diegetic_music:

A driving low percussive synth ostinato at 120 BPM, low volume, continuing beyond the cut point without resolution.
